finding: Across 30 European countries (2023, rho 0.75) the starting week is 33-40 h: 33 h in 2, 35 h in 3, 36 h in 4, 37 h in 4, 38 h in 8, 39 h in 7, 40 h in 2; EU27 aggregate 36 h

finding: With output and pay unchanged and the week falling as 1/(1+g) per year, a region starting at 35 h reaches 30 h in 28 years at France's 2015-19 productivity trend (0.57%/yr), 254 years at the 2015-23 trend (0.06%/yr), 16 years at 1%/yr, 8 years at 2%/yr
